model_config.host_context: Apple laptop, macOS, release build of the measured commit; one run each; dev and dev-zk measured back to back on the same host with no other workload; BSD /usr/bin/time -l.

model.cqis: int8 matrices, dynamic rows, random small codes
model.name: synthetic-e2e eight-layer (research/cqis-model-contract/synthetic_e2e.py)

note: RFC-0026 development tier (RFC-0018 A1): no security level, FS unproven, PCS conjectural. dev-zk profile (RFC-0013 A5, RFC-0026 A9 profile byte 1), defined and implemented, admission pending independent review (RFC-0013 A5 item 8); zero knowledge is conditional and computational (seed-derived masks), with the weights committed per proof (P = 1). Prover time is the prove-dev process wall time: Artifact decode, weight commitment, executor capture, plain check and proof. Verifier time is the verify-dev process wall time. CPU only, no GPU. Peak RSS is BSD time maximum resident set size. Measured as the dev against dev-zk pair of task E12-14b on one host; not comparable to the 4-vCPU E17-00 records; not a cost-model fit input.
